messages:
lee: opened docs PR #5018 to overhaul the "hello-pulse" quickstart: simplify onboarding, switch main auth example to ephemeral tokens, add a minimal Docker deploy snippet, and update sample links. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5018

anya: love this. For the auth piece, did you keep any server-exchange guidance or is it pure client demo now?

lee: kept a short server-exchange subsection under "When to move to production". main path is ephemeral client tokens so first-run is frictionless. server exchange gets a checklist (endpoint, refresh cadence, scope mapping).

sam: CI linkcheck flagged samples/pulse -> looks like sample repo renamed to samples/pulse-kit.

ci-bot: build failed — jobs/docs/linkcheck — 1 broken link: /samples/pulse -> 404

lee: fixed the sample path and added a note about pinning the sample commit SHA in docs to avoid future drift. pushed commit.

maria: quick naming nit: Docker snippet sets REDWOOD_SECRET but the JavaScript examples reference REDWOOD_KEY in a couple places. can we align?

lee: good catch. standardized on REDWOOD_KEY across the guide and added an "Env var mapping" table that lists legacy names for folks on older samples.

anya: also add a tiny CORS troubleshooting box for local dev — a lot of new users hit CORS when they run the demo on localhost. include a curl example to validate Access-Control-Allow-Origin.

lee: added the curl example and a one-line Docker build suggestion: `docker build --build-arg NODE_ENV=production -t hello-pulse .` with a short explanation.

ci-bot: linkcheck OK; docs/lint reported one minor warning: docs/quickstart-hello-pulse.md:line 64 sentence length.

sam: editorial: prefer phrasing "recommended for demo/staging" instead of "production-ready" to avoid implying full production endorsement.

lee: updated wording. also expanded the migration checklist to three bullets: (1) rename env vars, (2) server token-exchange pattern, (3) pin sample SHA. linked the appendix to the samples token-exchange file.

maria: can we add a tiny GH Actions snippet in the CI section that runs `npm ci` + `npm run build` against the sample to catch sample regressions?

lee: added a minimal check step that fires when docs PRs touch sample links. pushed and requested reviews from @anya and @sam.

ci-bot: build passed — docs/linkcheck + lint — requesting approvals.

anya: approved :thumbsup: thanks for the migration notes and curl sample.

sam: approved. :rocket: merging after a quick backport to release-2.x.

lee: merged PR #5018 (commit ghi789) into main. follow-up: opening a docs-only PR to update the samples repo README with recommended env var names and a tiny compatibility table. will also backport the migration appendix to the v2-guides branch. thanks everyone!
